newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end strong, boosted by firm rand.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end strong, boosted by firm rand.

text.p: South African industrial shares ended firm buoyed by a firmer currency and golds were firm despite a weak bullion price and a softer rand gold price.
Dealers said the turnaround unleashed an avalanche of support for rand hedge stocks and quality blue chip stocks.
Gold shares were also firm and dealers said they were recovering from an oversold position during the week on a weak currncy.
The overall index ended up 83.5 points to 6,975.3 points, the industrial index gained 84.5 points to 8,209.2 points and the gold index rose 24.2 points to 1,732.3.
